text_block_list.text:
Though not quite by a thousand horse 
lengths, Sakura Bakushin O still managed 
to defeat Nishino Flower.

However,
she wondered why her Trainer kept 
trying to steer her away from the
Bakushin 
Road. In order to persuade her, the 
Trainer—

She comes up with a plan to run a total
of 3,600 meters, straddling across three 
races: the Hakodate Sprint Stakes,
the CBC 
Sho, and the Centaur Stakes!

...Fascinated by the distance of 3,600 
meters,
Sakura Bakushin O gained momentum, 
determined to run all three races to the 
very end.
